note: Herentals: medieval earthen wall with stone gates, reduced in 1578 to behind the Nete and given pentagonal bastions and earth sconces (the old beguinage, left outside, became a Spanish fort). Traced from the Ferraris map (1777).
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Herentals' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140033)

gateSources.Bovenpoort: survives; inventory 140033 ('Bovenpoort alias Hoogpoort, poort van Diest')
